index.title: Classify and score incoming sponsorship emails
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Classify Score. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Classify and score incoming sponsorship emails. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A custom workflow and routine were set up to classify and score incoming sponsorship emails. The workflow uses a written rubric to classify the emails and apply labels to the mailbox. The routine runs on weekdays during working hours.
index.bot_name: Every sponsor email scored before you open it
